title: Normalized coordinate Tate tensor comparisons
statement: Fix the prime, coefficient extension, coefficient-tower base and operations, and Tate-tower family of [def-sp-coordinate-adjunction-categories]. Using the ordinary tower coordinate categories and right functors of [def-sp-coordinate-adjunction-categories], define Products to consist of finite signed-line products normalized on pure tensors, strict ordinary Tate-tower multiplication normalized after every evaluation, K-flat single-complex representatives, a chain map normalized on its degree-zero summand, and its specified derived image. Define the total tensor shift isomorphisms by the signed total-complex maps, and TensorShifts to consist of the two derived tensor shift isomorphisms whose maps on every K-flat pair agree with these total-complex shifts through the recorded tensor-model comparison. This defines data and equations without asserting their existence.
